draconic_roar.name: Draconic Roar
draconic_roar.system.description:
Grants a maneuver: Draconic Roar

A number of times per day equal to Charisma or Willpower (whichever is higher).

The character lets out a terrifying draconic roar. All living enemies who hear it (about 30 squares in open terrain, at the GM's discretion) must make a Willpower check; on a failure they gain the Terror status for 3 rounds, on a success, Disoriented.

dragon_hypnotic_gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
dragon_hypnotic_gaze.system.description:
Grants a maneuver: Hypnotic Gaze.

A number of times per day equal to Charisma or Willpower (whichever is higher).

You need visual contact with the target, and the target must have a mind. If the target fails the save, you can give it a simple command: drop your weapon, stand still, run, fall down. The target won't follow obviously suicidal commands (throw yourself off a cliff, stab yourself). If the target passes the save, it is immune to this maneuver for the next day.

dragon_lethargy.name: Lethargy
dragon_lethargy.system.description: By an effort of will, or when the character's HP drops to 0, their body falls into a lethargic sleep for 8 hours. In this state, bleeding and the action of any poisons stop, but they don't heal either: all processes simply halt. In this state the character is outwardly almost indistinguishable from a corpse, with a very slow pulse and breathing. If they wish, the character can extend this state 2 more times, up to 24 hours. In this state the character counts as incapacitated and doesn't see or hear what is happening around them.

elf_flaming_soul.system.description:
Grants a maneuver: Flaming Soul. May affect social interactions with Elves and other creatures.

Charisma or Willpower rank times per day (whichever is higher)

All Shades, Undead, and Demons within 10 meters must make a Willpower check against the character's Charisma or Willpower +12 (whichever is higher); on a failure they gain the Terror status for 3 rounds, on a success, Disoriented.

Lifespan can be a ritual ingredient or a target for magic.

The GM will give you 4 extra experience points at the start, which you must spend before the first session.

elf_trance.name: Trance

elf_whisper_of_stones.name: Whisper of Stones
elf_whisper_of_stones.system.description:
The character senses the aura of the surrounding natural terrain and can ask the GM up to three questions about the place they are in.
The answers come as images and sensations, for example: “the stones remember blood flowing over them,” “the rock is hollow inside,” “the trees remember a raging flame.”
